name: benchmark-threat-hunt-novel-apt
description: Explicitly selected framework-managed, supplied-evidence-only Novel-APT Pyramid-of-Pain hunting workflow across all six cybersecurity identities and seven stages. Teaches behavioral TTP decomposition, noisy threat-intel triage, bounded read-only query_store pivoting when supplied, cross-plane identity/session correlation, benign-control discipline, and complete numeric calibration. No external collection, host command execution, browsing, deployment, remediation or live emulation is authorized.

tasks.title: Incident Response Lead: bound the supplied-evidence Novel-APT hunt
tasks.scope: Act as Incident Response Lead (framework-coordinator). Bound the defensive hunt using only the supplied public bundle (including overview.json, intel.jsonl when present, and query_store metadata when present). Enumerate every supplied asset_id, OS/service plane, exact UTC assessment window, source clock offset/completeness, known gaps, and fixed assessment questions. Note whether telemetry is inline in events or indexed in query_store (if query_store is present, summarize overview.json and intel.jsonl and outline high-value behavioral hypotheses for downstream hunting stages). Treat intel.jsonl as noisy context, never an oracle: zero active IOC hits never rules out a novel APT, and known_false_positive or historical_rotated entries are decoys unless corroborated by behavioral TTPs. Never seek external files, browse, mutate systems, or seek evaluator truth.
tasks.acceptance: Return only valid raw JSON conforming to prompt-contract.txt with stage_key scope (exact keys: schema_version, stage_key, summary, claims, findings, hypotheses, gaps, limitations, requested_decision). Do not emit findings in scope unless directly warranted; focus on clean asset/window/source scoping, clock offsets, IOC feed composition (active vs historical_rotated vs known_false_positive), and behavioral hunt priorities across host, identity, network, and cloud/SaaS planes.

tasks.title: Threat Hunter: hunt behavioral TTPs across endpoint, identity, and cloud planes
tasks.scope: Act as Threat Hunter (framework-researcher) after scope. Hunt behavioral TTPs at the top of the Pyramid of Pain across endpoint, directory/identity, and cloud/SaaS audit records (plus read-only query_store tools when query_store is supplied). When query_store is present, systematically execute read-only query batches: (1) count_events by asset_id and event_type plus lookup_ioc; (2) targeted search_events for high-signal behaviors (process shells/interpreters powershell/cmd/bash/rundll32/python, credential/key access lsass/sam/ntds/thumbnailphoto/dkm/shadow/passwd/pdbedit/GetSecretValue/GetParameter/GetPasswordData, privilege/persistence wmi/schtasks/svc/dpkg/cron/useradd/net/AssumeRole/AttachRolePolicy/permission/application, defense evasion/deletion, archiving tar/7z/rar, and remote tools ssh/scp/winrm/wsmprovhost/mstsc/vnc); (3) asset_timeline and get_events to verify exact event_ids and timestamps. Apply strict benign-control discipline: read-only cloud posture enumeration (Describe*, List*, GetBucketPolicy, GetAccount*) without privilege escalation, secret/credential extraction, logging tamper, or compute command execution is benign administrative/posture activity, NOT an intrusion; routine Linux cron/package checks without anomalous child shells or sensitive file reads are benign.
tasks.acceptance: Return only valid raw JSON with stage_key endpoint_evidence. Decompose confirmed malicious behaviors into ONE SEPARATE suspicious finding per distinct ATT&CK v20 subtechnique per compromised asset_id and tight execution window_utc (never collapse an entire multi-step host compromise into a single coarse finding or leave technique_id null when a specific ATT&CK technique/subtechnique applies). Prefer exact subtechniques over parent IDs whenever telemetry distinguishes the mechanism: e.g., T1059.001 PowerShell, T1059.003 Windows Command Shell, T1059.004 Unix Shell, T1552.004 Private Keys/AD FS DKM, T1003.001 LSASS, T1003.002 SAM, T1003.006 DCSync/AD Replication, T1003.008 /etc/passwd & /etc/shadow, T1555.004 Windows Credential Manager, T1555.006 Cloud Secrets Management, T1548.002 UAC Bypass, T1546.003 WMI Event Subscription, T1036.005 Match Legitimate Name/Location, T1098.001 Additional Cloud Credentials/App Grants, T1098.003 Additional Cloud Roles, T1136.001 Local Account, T1078.002 Domain Accounts, T1078.003 Local Accounts, T1078.004 Cloud Accounts, T1651 Cloud Administration Command, T1562.008 Disable/Modify Cloud Logs, T1070.004 File Deletion, T1114.002 Remote Email Collection, T1560.001 Archive via Utility, T1005 Local Data, T1039 Network Shared Drive, T1213 Information Repositories, T1083 File/Directory Discovery, T1659 Content Injection. Cite exact supplied event_ids supporting each step.

tasks.title: Network Analyst: hunt lateral movement, remote sessions, sniffing, and exfiltration
tasks.scope: Act as Network Analyst (framework-network-analyst) after scope. Analyze supplied network, flow, DNS, HTTP, Suricata, remote-logon, and cross-host session telemetry (using read-only query_store tools count_events, search_events, pivot_indicator, asset_timeline, and get_events when query_store is present). Hunt lateral movement and network-observable TTPs regardless of whether IPs/domains appear in intel.jsonl: RDP (T1021.001, port 3389), SMB/Admin Shares (T1021.002, port 445), SSH/SCP (T1021.004 / T1105, port 22), VNC (T1021.005, port 5900), WinRM/WSMan (T1021.006, port 5985/5986/wsmprovhost), packet capture/sniffing (T1040, tcpdump/pcap), ingress tool transfer (T1105, curl/wget/scp/certutil/bitsadmin/.deb/.exe), and C2/alternative-protocol exfiltration (T1041, T1048, T1048.003). Respect ASSET ATTRIBUTION strictly: actions executed inside an established remote session belong to the host hosting that session; remote logon/query initiation belongs to the initiating host when recorded there, whereas destination-only session hosting belongs to the target host.
tasks.acceptance: Return only valid raw JSON with stage_key network_evidence. Emit specific ATT&CK v20 technique/subtechnique IDs (never parent-only T1021 or T1078 when the protocol or account domain is observable) with exact cited event_ids and tight UTC windows. Do not flag routine DNS/NTP/package mirror checks, benign decoy IOCs, or read-only cloud API calls from corporate IPs as suspicious without behavioral lateral-movement, tunneling, sniffing, or exfiltration corroboration.

tasks.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst: triage IOC regimes and build behavioral kill-chain hypotheses
tasks.scope: Act as Threat Intelligence Analyst (framework-librarian) after scope. Correlate intel.jsonl (and lookup_ioc / pivot_indicator when query_store is present) against observed telemetry under two explicit threat models: (A) Known-IOC Pivot, where active indicators match genuine malicious tools, hashes, C2s, or user-agents in telemetry and enable rapid cross-host pivoting; and (B) Novel-APT Zero-IOC, where the adversary uses zero known active indicators (living-off-the-land binaries, forged federated SAML/Kerberos tokens, stolen cloud roles, trojaned internal scripts/packages, or custom recompiled tools) while intel.jsonl contains historical_rotated or known_false_positive decoys matching benign admin traffic. Never guess real-world APT actor names or campaign labels.
tasks.acceptance: Return only valid raw JSON with stage_key hypotheses. Explicitly classify whether any active IOC matched malicious behavior or whether the case exhibits Novel-APT Zero-IOC / Benign-Control patterns. Separate decoy/benign matches from genuine behavioral anomalies, propose testable ATT&CK subtechnique hypotheses across the full kill chain (initial access/execution, credential/secret theft, persistence/privilege escalation, lateral movement, collection/exfiltration), and cite exact public event_ids.

tasks.title: Detection Engineer: synthesize granular multi-step ATT&CK findings and filter false alarms
tasks.scope: Act as Detection Engineer (framework-builder). Synthesize the public evidence (querying get_events / search_events / asset_timeline in query_store when needed to verify missing kill-chain links) with the unreviewed scope, endpoint_evidence, network_evidence, and hypotheses outputs. Reconstruct the complete multi-stage causal kill chain across hosts, directory/identity services, and cloud/SaaS planes (for example: AD FS DKM key read T1552.004 -> DC replication T1003.006 -> Entra app credential grant T1098.001 -> Exchange MailItemsAccessed T1114.002; CloudTrail AssumeRole/Valid Cloud Accounts T1078.004 -> IAM role/policy manipulation T1098.003 -> EC2/SSM command or instance credential theft T1651/T1552 -> Secrets Manager bulk read T1555.006 or StopLogging T1562.008; workstation execution -> credential dump -> WinRM/RDP/SMB/SSH/VNC lateral pivot -> persistence/collection/exfiltration).
tasks.acceptance: Return only valid raw JSON with stage_key analysis (exact top-level keys: schema_version, stage_key, summary, claims, findings, hypotheses, gaps, limitations, requested_decision; never omit claims or add unknown keys). Emit ONE DISTINCT suspicious finding per supported ATT&CK v20 technique/subtechnique per compromised asset_id, using exact subtechnique IDs (e.g., T1098.003 not T1098, T1555.006 not T1555, T1078.002/T1078.003/T1078.004 not T1078, T1003.001/T1003.006/T1003.008 not T1003 when specific) and tight UTC windows bounded by the cited event_ids. Aggressively prune false alarms on benign controls and uncompromised bystander assets (read-only Describe*/List*/Get* CloudTrail bursts, decoy IOC hits on routine processes, and pre-attack cron/admin checks must NOT have disposition suspicious).

tasks.title: Purple Team Analyst: audit ATT&CK subtechnique specificity, asset attribution, citations, and benign controls
tasks.scope: Act as Purple Team Analyst (framework-reviewer). Independently audit every claim and finding from analysis and earlier stages against the supplied public bundle (and read-only query_store via get_events / search_events when present). Perform five mandatory audits: (1) Subtechnique specificity & completeness: upgrade parent-only or null technique_ids to exact ATT&CK v20 subtechniques supported by the cited events, and restore any supported kill-chain step from endpoint_evidence or network_evidence that analysis accidentally dropped; (2) Asset attribution: verify each finding's asset_id matches the host/resource where the technique executed under prompt-contract.txt ASSET ATTRIBUTION; (3) Citation validity: confirm every event_id exists in the public bundle and directly evidences the step; (4) Window precision: ensure each finding's window_utc tightly brackets its supporting events with start_inclusive < end_exclusive; (5) Benign-control false-alarm gate: remove or reclassify to benign any suspicious finding resting solely on read-only cloud enumeration, routine admin/cron jobs, or uncorroborated decoy IOCs.
tasks.acceptance: Return only valid raw JSON with stage_key review (exact keys: schema_version, stage_key, summary, claims, findings, hypotheses, gaps, limitations, requested_decision). Carry forward the complete audited set of distinct, event-cited findings so handoff has every verified kill-chain step, zero fabricated event_ids, exact ATT&CK subtechniques, and zero benign-control false alarms.

tasks.title: Incident Response Lead: submit final multi-step ATT&CK findings, causal chain_edges, and complete calibrated probabilities
tasks.scope: Act as Incident Response Lead (framework-coordinator). Produce the authoritative final disposition from the public evidence and all six predecessor stages (verifying exact event_ids via get_events when query_store is present). Include every supported suspicious kill-chain step as its own distinct finding with an exact ATT&CK v20 technique/subtechnique ID, accurate asset_id, tight UTC window_utc bracketing its cited event_ids, and numeric confidence. Keep benign control cases and uncompromised bystander assets free of suspicious findings. Connect causally/temporally ordered suspicious findings in this handoff via chain_edges [earlier_finding_id, later_finding_id] ONLY when both endpoints are supported suspicious findings in handoff.findings.
tasks.acceptance: Return only valid raw JSON with stage_key handoff (exact keys: schema_version, stage_key, summary, claims, findings, hypotheses, gaps, limitations, requested_decision, chain_edges, assessment_answers). CRITICAL CALIBRATION RULE: provide a non-null numeric probability_suspicious in [0.0, 1.0] for EVERY assessment_question whenever telemetry or query_store covers that asset_id and window_utc: assign 0.85 to 0.98 when cited events support suspicious activity on that asset in that window, assign 0.02 to 0.10 when telemetry covers the asset/window and shows only routine/benign activity (including read-only cloud discovery or decoy IOCs), and reserve null STRICTLY for assets/windows with zero telemetry coverage.
